description: Defines adapter classes for PDCP to RRC communication in a 5G/4G network stack, including RX, TX, and control adapters.

classes.name: pdcp_rrc_ue_rx_adapter
classes.description: Adapter for handling incoming PDCP SDUs and protocol/control failures, forwarding data to RRC.

classes.name: pdcp_rrc_ue_tx_adapter
classes.description: Adapter for handling outgoing PDCP PDUs, including re-transmissions and discards.

classes.name: pdcp_tx_control_rrc_ue_adapter
classes.description: Adapter for handling PDCP transmission control events and failures.

methods.name: on_new_sdu
methods.description: Handles new SDU received from PDCP, stores in internal buffer.

methods.name: on_protocol_failure
methods.description: Handles protocol failure events, triggers UE release.

methods.name: on_integrity_failure
methods.description: Handles integrity check failures, triggers UE release.

methods.name: on_max_count_reached
methods.description: Handles max count reached event, triggers UE release.

methods.name: on_resume_required
methods.description: Handles resume request, logs unsupported operation.

methods.name: pop_result
methods.description: Returns accumulated SDUs or cause of failure.

methods.name: on_new_pdu
methods.description: Stores new outgoing PDU, marks if re-transmission.
